cancellationReview.conclusion: One cancellation vote does not suspend this 2-of-3 proposal. If valid execution lands before cancellation threshold, execution wins and later cancellation cannot undo it. Full cancellation first blocks execute and reapproval.
cancellationReview.scope: Four deterministic sequential orderings in synthetic 2-of-3 12h VM. Not concurrent validator execution, mainnet transaction ordering, a fee/MEV strategy, or proof for every governance configuration.

delayedReview.scope: Synthetic pinned SBF runtime; tight limits, one market move per operation. Not exhaustive market/expiry protection.
delayedReview.warning: Slippage rejection alone leaves proposal Approved. Recovery tested here explicitly cancels stale proposal with governance votes, verifies execute rejection, then re-quotes and obtains new approvals and timelock. No automatic expiry is proved.
